name: elastic-relevance-studio
description: Official plugin marketplace for Elasticsearch Relevance Studio

plugins.name: relevance-studio
plugins.description: Manage the full search relevance engineering lifecycle in Elasticsearch Relevance Studio: scenarios, judgements, strategies, benchmarks, and evaluations.

mcp_url.title: Relevance Studio MCP URL
mcp_url.description: URL of the Relevance Studio MCP Server, including the /mcp path, e.g. https://localhost:4200/mcp (use http:// when TLS_ENABLED=false)

auth_header.title: Authorization header value
auth_header.description: Full Authorization header value for the MCP Server, e.g. 'ApiKey <base64 id:api_key>', 'Basic <base64 username:password>', or 'Bearer <base64 id:api_key>'. Leave blank if AUTH_ENABLED=false on the MCP Server.
